title: Oracle Analytics Inactive Account Reclamation
app: Oracle Analytics Server/Cloud usage tracking and audit via DB Connect and BI Server logs via UF.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=oracle:analytics:usage
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by user_id
| eval days_idle=round((now()-last_seen)/86400)
| where days_idle>60
| sort - days_idle
description: Lists Oracle Analytics accounts with no activity in over 60 days so administrators can reclaim licenses and reduce the access surface.
value: Idle Oracle Analytics accounts waste license spend and widen the attack surface; a periodic reclamation list turns both into routine housekeeping.
implementation: Ingest Oracle Analytics activity events; schedule monthly and route the idle-account list to identity/license owners.
visualization: Table of account by days idle, reclamation candidate list.
grandmaExplanation: We find Oracle Analytics accounts nobody uses anymore so their licences can be freed and access tidied up.
